task.description: Design frontend components and pages for Stage F4 task inbox features: task list page, task detail panel, form rendering for task completion, task claim/reassign dialogs, badge count, escalation indicator, mobile UI.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all 10 requirement acceptance criteria
Component hierarchy specified with props and types

result.summary: Created comprehensive Type E design for Stage F4 task inbox frontend covering all 10 requirements (TK-UI-01 through TK-UI-10). Design includes TaskInboxPage, TaskDetailPanel with dynamic form rendering, mobile-responsive layout, task operations (claim/reassign/complete), and badge count polling.
